title: Capitolo 12 · The future, indirect pronouns, real life — A2 review
shortDescription: The futuro semplice for plans, forecasts and promises (parlerò, sarò, avrò, andrò, farò), the indirect pronouns (mi, ti, gli, le, ci, vi) and the connectors perché, quindi, però, anche se, three real-life situations (post office and Comune, a job interview, phoning the plumber), then the complete A1–A2 review and the final A2 test.
description:
Part of the official SS Europa Italian course used in our classes, for learners from India, Pakistan and Bangladesh who are going to Italy to work, study or live. Chapters 1–7 take you from zero to level A1 and Chapters 8–12 to level A2 — study them in order.

Every 60-minute class of the chapter is split into three short lessons you can study on your phone, with pictures, audio, grammar tables and exercises. Every word comes with its English and Punjabi meaning, the slides of each class are attached as PDF, and the chapter ends with a test (pass mark 60%).

This chapter also has the final A2 test (Chapters 8–12); the written part and the oral interview are done with your teacher.
objectives:
I can talk about my plans and make forecasts with the futuro semplice
I can use the irregular futures: sarò, avrò, andrò, farò, verrò, potrò, dovrò
I can use the indirect pronouns: gli telefono, le regalo un fiore, ti consiglio…
I can link sentences with perché, quindi, però, anche se
I can manage the post office, the Comune, a simple job interview and a call about a repair at home
I can use the 4 main tenses together — level A2

blocks.title: Prova 1 · Le domande dell'esaminatore
blocks.body:
1. Come ti chiami, da dove vieni e dove abiti adesso? (**presente**)
2. Che cosa facevi nel tuo Paese prima di venire in Italia? (**imperfetto**)
3. Quando sei arrivato/a in Italia e cosa hai fatto all'inizio? (**passato prossimo**)
4. Quali progetti hai per il lavoro, lo studio o le vacanze? (**futuro**)

blocks.title: Simulazione a coppie: scegli una carta
blocks.body:
- **Carta A · situazione pratica (Lei formale):** colloquio o ufficio pubblico — usa *vorrei, posso, quindi, perché* e i pronomi indiretti.
- **Carta B · confronto ieri e oggi:** città vs campagna / Paese vs Italia — usa imperfetto, presente e comparativi (*più … di / che, meno … di, -issimo*).

blocks.title: Test finale livello A2
blocks.body:
This is the final test of level A2. It checks everything in Chapters 8–12.

- **1. Listening** — sentences and a story in past, present and future
- **2. Vocabulary** — travel, health, daily life and offices
- **3. Grammar** — the tenses, the pronouns, the imperative and comparisons
- **4. Writing** — my story: yesterday, today and tomorrow

You need **60%** to pass. You can repeat the test as many times as you like.
